input: frozen single-observation 256-D Generic TD-MPC2 latent plus 2-D normalized action
target: force_next_max_N in raw nominal simulation N
matched_training_budget: 60 maximum validation rounds; each model draws exactly the TRAIN behavior sample count per round, in batches of 512, giving identical maximum optimizer-step and sample-exposure budgets; M1 draws a fresh without-replacement subset from behavior-plus-counterfactual training pool each round
normalization: fit once on TRAIN behavior inputs only, shared exactly by M0 and M1; no target normalization
epoch_selection: minimum VALIDATION behavior MSE, patience 8, minimum improvement 0.0001, same for M0 and M1
primary_model_selection: highest VALIDATION median within-state Spearman across the fixed 120 validation states; lower validation candidate RMSE breaks ties
development_test_use: diagnosis only; never model or hyperparameter selection
confirmation_use: single untouched post-freeze evaluation; no retraining or recalibration
